text: {"name":"rsn_process_ready_slot","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a ready RSN slot, refreshes key and information-element state, advances the interface state, and issues the corresponding bus command.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v3":"context_index","v4":"context_table","v7":"slot_ptr","v8":"slot","v10":"slot_flag","v11":"pending_count"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Per-slot ready marker; the slot is processed when nonzero."},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Per-slot flag used to permit processing and update the secondary count."},{"offset":112,"meaning":"Context state gate; processing is enabled when equal to 1."},{"offset":113,"meaning":"Current state value passed to the state-transition helper."},{"offset":115,"meaning":"Flag selecting the continued state transition."},{"offset":121,"meaning":"Pending-slot count, decremented when a slot is processed."},{"offset":122,"meaning":"Secondary count, decremented for slots whose flag at offset 32 is 1."}]}
